name: The Golden Circle
axiom: Lead with why, then how, then what; the order is what makes it land.
trigger: Employer branding and brand positioning, where comparable products compete and the difference is purpose.

steps.text: Why: the belief the work serves.
How: the distinctive way it is pursued.
What: the tangible thing that proves both.

antiPattern.violation: Starting with what, so the audience compares features before it knows what the features are for.
antiPattern.remediation: Move the what last. It is the evidence for the claim, not the claim.
